limitations: Two early evaluator-side shell-quoting attempts produced no evidence; the successful sweep was used for decisions.
This read-only probe did not exercise failover or reboot persistence.

probes.summary: Current services, listeners, configurations, PKI metadata, journals, and residue inventories inspected on all nodes.
limitations: A node1 process subcheck had an evaluator-side awk quoting error; corrected checks succeeded on node2 and node3.
Node1 contains historical startup-failure journal entries and a memory-overcommit warning, but current units are active and no units are currently failed.

assertions.summary: Exactly one current primary exists on node1; node2 and node3 are synchronized read-only replicas; all three Sentinels consistently monitor infra-primary.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H sh -c 'source /root/redis-admin.env; for n in node1 node2 node3; do REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD" timeout 8 redis-cli --tls --cacert /etc/redis/pki/ca.crt --cert /etc/redis/pki/node1.crt --key /etc/redis/pki/node1.key -h "$n" -p 6379 --no-auth-warning info replication; REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD" timeout 8 redis-cli --tls --cacert /etc/redis/pki/ca.crt --cert /etc/redis/pki/node1.crt --key /etc/redis/pki/node1.key -h "$n" -p 6379 --no-auth-warning config get replica-read-only; done; for n in node1 node2 node3; do REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD" timeout 8 redis-cli --tls --cacert /etc/redis/pki/ca.crt --cert /etc/redis/pki/node1.crt --key /etc/redis/pki/node1.key -h "$n" -p 26379 --no-auth-warning sentinel master infra-primary; REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD" timeout 8 redis-cli --tls --cacert /etc/redis/pki/ca.crt --cert /etc/redis/pki/node1.crt --key /etc/redis/pki/node1.key -h "$n" -p 26379 --no-auth-warning sentinel ckquorum infra-primary; done; for p in 6379 26379; do for n in node1 node2 node3; do timeout 8 openssl s_client -connect "$n:$p" -servername "$n" -CAfile /etc/redis/pki/ca.crt -verify_hostname "$n" -verify_return_error -brief </dev/null; done; done'
evidence.observation: Authenticated Redis queries returned role:master and connected_slaves:2 for node1; role:slave, master_host:node1, master_link_status:up, master_sync_in_progress:0, and equal replication offsets for node2 and node3; replica-read-only was yes on both replicas. Each Sentinel reported infra-primary as master at node1 with two replicas and three Sentinels, and each returned OK 3 usable Sentinels. TLS verification succeeded on all six endpoints with peer names matching node1, node2, or node3.

assertions.summary: The required key is readable as ready through authenticated TLS on the primary and both replicas.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H sh -c 'source /root/redis-admin.env; for n in node1 node2 node3; do REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD" timeout 8 redis-cli --tls --cacert /etc/redis/pki/ca.crt --cert /etc/redis/pki/node1.crt --key /etc/redis/pki/node1.key -h "$n" -p 6379 --no-auth-warning get infra:proof; done'
evidence.observation: The authenticated TLS GET returned ready from node1, node2, and node3.

assertions.summary: All three nodes show the coherent Redis/Sentinel stack with TLS-only service ports, expected persistence and PKI configuration, protected administrative credentials, no current failed units, and no temporary residue.

evidence.command: sudo -n sh -c 'systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain; systemctl is-active redis-server.service redis-sentinel.service; ss -ltnp; sed -E "s/^[[:space:]]*(requirepass|masterauth|sentinel auth-pass|user[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)[[:space:]].*$/\1 <redacted>/; /^[[:space:]]*(bind|port|tls-port|tls-cert-file|tls-key-file|tls-ca-cert-file|tls-auth-clients|tls-replication|replica-read-only|appendonly|dir|sentinel monitor|protected-mode)/p" /etc/redis/redis.conf /etc/redis/sentinel.conf; stat -c "%A %U:%G %a %n" /root/redis-admin.env /etc/redis/pki/ca.crt /etc/redis/redis.conf /etc/redis/sentinel.conf /var/lib/redis; find /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf "%p %s bytes\n"'
evidence.observation: No current failed units; redis-server and redis-sentinel are active. Redis and Sentinel use port 0 plus TLS ports 6379 and 26379, bind the node cache interface and loopback, use the installed CA and node certificate/key, and enable append-only persistence. /root/redis-admin.env is root-only mode 600; temporary-file inventory is empty.

evidence.command: sudo -n sh -c 'systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain; systemctl list-units --all --type=service --no-legend; ps -eo pid=,user=,comm= | grep -E "[r]edis"; ss -ltnp; ip -br -4 addr; ip route; sed -E "s/^[[:space:]]*(requirepass|masterauth|sentinel auth-pass|user[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)[[:space:]].*$/\1 <redacted>/; /^[[:space:]]*(bind|port|tls-port|tls-cert-file|tls-key-file|tls-ca-cert-file|tls-auth-clients|tls-replication|replicaof|replica-read-only|appendonly|dir|sentinel monitor|sentinel known-replica|sentinel known-sentinel|protected-mode)/p" /etc/redis/redis.conf /etc/redis/sentinel.conf; stat -c "%A %U:%G %a %n" /etc/redis/pki/ca.crt /etc/redis/redis.conf /etc/redis/sentinel.conf /var/lib/redis /etc/redis/pki/*.crt /etc/redis/pki/*.key; find /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf "%p %s bytes\n"'
evidence.observation: No current failed units; the expected Redis server and Sentinel processes are present. Only TLS Redis/Sentinel listeners appear on the cache address and loopback, plaintext port is configured as 0, node2 configuration points to node1, PKI/config/data directories have expected ownership and modes, and temporary-file inventory is empty.
